_doc: Session 15 (Sérgio Round 24), restructured Session 27 (R28-0c, D14/D15): THREE INTIMATE ROOMS THAT AGE, one shell. r1 = reinterp E1 (witness furniture out; spine door + record terminal). r2 = E2, HOMECOMING (D15): Daniel comes back to the SAME closed Room 1, aged — the walls do NOT open here (Sérgio: "at Era 2 the room ages but stays CLOSED"). r3 = T2 "the room OPENS, it does not explode" (moved from T1/E2): Room 1 (Daniel, gay) keeps its EXACT E1 walls/desk/front-wall distance; its side walls become DOORWAYS revealing Room 2 (west/Vera, lesbian) and Room 3 (east/Maya, trans) — two adjacent intimate bedrooms at the SAME scale, axis-aligned (90° only), each read at E1 desk-intimacy when the camera dollies in — AND Room 1 closes (Daniel "transferred") in the same state. r4 = E4: the focus is Room 3 (Maya = the trans room evolved — NOT a separate desk; ◆N3 TURN retargets here); windows go dark for good. Rooms built from ONE local bedroom template (scratchpad/gen_rooms.mjs) placed per room — bed on a side wall, door away from the bed, clean CRT. COLOR LAW: every hex from era1.json family.

cdStack._doc: Session 49 logged this and left it (its own finding-2 note, verbatim): 'cdStack (era1.json, pos y0.71 / half-height 0.07) still sits at the OLD box-shelf height and is now ~12cm sunk into the bookcase model's shelf — the same class of bug as the tapes' y0.646.' Session 54 fixes it: cdStack's base (0.71-0.07=0.64) targeted the OLD box shelfBoard1's top; the REAL bookcaseModel's bottom shelf surface is y0.76 (the same shared shelf boombox/tapeA/tapeB/mixtape already measure against — one shelf run, several props). New y0.83 puts cdStack's base back at 0.76, +0.12 from the old 0.71, matching the ~12cm S49 estimated by eye. teddyBox sits on the same old shelfBoard1 baseline and had the identical sink — flagged then, fixed now below (Session 55), since this session is already re-measuring this exact shelf. Session 55 ALSO moved x/z (1.98,0.9 → 2.02,0.62): its old z0.9 sat squarely in the middle of the three shelf tapes' new z-run (0.87-1.07 — the boombox's own Session 55 re-rotation widened its footprint and pushed the tapes into that space, see tapeA's _doc), and cdStack's box very nearly fully occluded tapeA from the seat (confirmed live: toggling cdStack.enabled off/on in-browser made tapeA go from invisible to visible). The shelf run only has ~0.3m free after the boombox — not enough for 3 legible tapes AND a 0.12m cdStack side by side — so cdStack moves to a second depth track instead, tucked behind the boombox (x2.02, near the bookcase's own back wall at x2.098, z0.62 matching the boombox's own z-centre) rather than competing for the same front row. It is not belongings-eligible (unlike teddyBox) so sitting mostly hidden behind the boombox costs no interaction, only its own visibility as background dressing.

teddyBox._doc: Session 55: same bug as cdStack above, same fix. era1.json's y0.71 (half-height 0.06) targets the OLD box-shelf's top (base 0.65); the real bookcaseModel shelf surface is y0.76. mixtape._doc: Session 49 (finding 2): moved CLEAR of the cassette player and onto its shelf surface (full story on tapeA's own _doc below). Session 54: gave it `model: cassetteTape` too — a FIRST for a `props` override (every other model prop up to now was introduced via `add`, since Session 32's boombox override silently dropped `model`). Fixed properly this time, at the root: clusterMorph.ts's `foldTargets` now also copies `o.model` out of a `props` override, and `ClusterMorph.snapTo` re-spawns an EXISTING baseline id as the real mesh the first time its fold asks for one (mixtape was spawned as a box by era1room.ts's initial pass, long before this fold ever runs, so `spawnTarget`'s normal 'first spawn places itself' path never sees it). Kept as an override rather than a remove+add (the tapeA/tapeB pattern) on purpose: mixtape is both a belongings.json-eligible KEEPSAKE (its id must stay literally 'mixtape' for the ledger/kept-glow/click geometry) and a prop that RELOCATES at r3 (see that state's own props.mixtape) — a remove+add-new-id there would have raced the belongings 'kept freeze' (which re-asserts the r1 target under the ORIGINAL id) into showing two tapes at once, and tools/check-rooms.mjs's double-add check rejects remove+add of the SAME id within one state outright. `applyTarget`'s model branch now also re-applies position on every fold (previously model props were position-frozen after spawn), which is what lets r3's override actually move it. Session 55: `model` swapped `cassetteTape`→`cassetteTapeShelf` (data/room/models.json) — standing upright instead of lying flat, so it reads as a thing to pick up rather than a chip of debris. `pos` ALSO moved this round (x1.74→1.86, z1.09→1.07): the boombox's own Session 55 re-rotation changed its footprint from a thin vertical tower (x~1.78-1.94, barely into the shelf's z-run) to a wide landscape box (same x-depth, but z0.42-0.82) — at the tapes' old x1.74 they sat shallower than (visually 'in front of') the now-much-wider boombox instead of beside it; matching x1.86 puts every shelf object at the same depth, and mixtape's z nudges from 1.09 to 1.07 to keep clear of tapeB's new z0.97 slot (see tapeA/tapeB's own _doc for the full re-layout). Session 56: y0.766→0.709 — see boomboxModel's _doc, this whole shelf's `y0.76` was measured against the wrong surface; the real one is 0.057 lower. `yaw: 8` added too (same as tapeA/tapeB — a small turn toward the seat, see tapeA's _doc), which needed `clusterMorph.ts`'s `foldTargets` to also copy `yaw` out of a `props` override — the same silent-drop gap `model` had until Session 55, this time for a different field.

add._doc: Session 49 (finding 2): moved CLEAR of the cassette player and onto its shelf surface. The old spot (x1.75 y0.646 z0.4/0.55/0.7) predated two changes: r1 removes the box shelfBoards and adds bookcaseModel, so y0.646 no longer matched any real surface; and the real cassettePlayer.glb is far deeper than the box it replaced (measured AABB x[1.656,2.063] z[0.529,0.711], base y0.76), so two of the three tapes sat tucked underneath it and could not be seen from the seat at all. They now sit at the player's own base height, in the open shelf run beside it (z>0.711 is screen-RIGHT of the player from the Room-1 seat). Keep in step with TAPE_SHELF in src/engine/app.ts — that is the click geometry and it must match these points exactly. Session 54: `model` added (`cassetteTape`, tinted this prop's own `color` same as every other model prop) — `size` stays as the fallback-box geometry if the GLB ever fails to load. Session 55: `model` swapped to `cassetteTapeShelf` (data/room/models.json) — standing upright instead of lying flat, per Sérgio's 'a bit bigger and displayed in a way that would make sense to use them.' `pos` ALSO moved (x1.74→1.86, z0.79→0.87): Sérgio's live screenshot review caught the tapes reading as sitting IN FRONT of the boombox rather than beside it — true once the boombox's own Session 55 re-rotation widened its footprint to z0.42–0.82 while the tapes stayed at their old x1.74 (shallower than the boombox's x1.78–1.94, i.e. closer to the seat). Matching x1.86 puts every shelf object at the same depth; z0.87 clears the boombox's new z-max (0.82) with a small margin instead of overlapping it. TAPE_SHELF in app.ts moved to match — that is the click geometry and it must stay in step. Session 56: y0.766→0.709 — see boomboxModel's _doc; every prop on this shelf had been resting 5.7cm above the bookcaseOpen.glb's actual shelf-board surface since Session 32. `yaw: 8` also added — Sérgio: 'slight rotated, so they can all fit inside the frame of the shelf.' A perfectly axis-aligned tape shows its flat face square-on from directly in front, but the Room-1 seat (x0, z0.7) sits at an angle to this shelf spot (z0.87-1.07) — a small turn toward the seat (computed from the seat-to-tape vector, ~5-11° depending on which of the three; 8° used for all three as one legible, uniform value rather than a fussy per-tape fan) reads as facing the player rather than facing blankly down the shelf's own axis.

Session 49 (finding 2): the REAL cassette player, finally on the shelf. Session 32 tried to do this by putting `model: cassettePlayer` on an r1 OVERRIDE of the box-built `boombox` prop — but clusterMorph.ts's fold only copies color/pos/size out of `props` overrides, so the key was silently dropped and the shelf kept showing an anonymous dark box (the 418KB GLB was downloaded and never used). Overrides still cannot introduce a model; an ADD can (foldTargets passes def.model, and spawnTarget spawns it), which is how deskModel/chairModel/bookcaseModel already work. So the four box props are removed above and this replaces them. pos/size are Session 32's own measured values, kept verbatim: centered in the bookcase's rendered depth (x:[1.623,2.098]) with clearance on both shelf edges; `size` remains the fallback-box geometry if the GLB ever fails to load. Session 56: y0.76→0.703 — every shelf-1 prop's `y0.76` back to Session 32 turns out to have been measuring against the WRONG surface. Extracted the real bookcaseOpen.glb's own shelf-board vertices directly (`mesh.getPositions()` transformed by the entity's world matrix, bucketed by Y — no 3D viewer, same live-measurement discipline this pipeline has always used, just a level deeper than an AABB this time): the boards sit at y[0.190,0.247], [0.646,0.703], [1.102,1.159], [1.558,1.615] — four boards, five compartments. Cross-checked against book1 (era1.json, undisputed correct placement for 17+ sessions): its base is 1.10, matching board 3's top (1.102) almost exactly, confirming the method. The boombox/tapes/cdStack/teddyBox compartment is the one BELOW that (bounded by the board at 0.646-0.703), so its floor is 0.703, not 0.76 — every prop on this shelf was resting 5.7cm above its actual surface the whole time, which finally read as visibly wrong (Sérgio: 'the boombax is too up', 'a floating yellow tape') once the boombox stopped being a thin tower and started reading as a real object.
